senses.gloss: लक्ष्मण- + अनुचर लक्ष्मण- + अनुचर, adj. accompanied by Lakṣmaṇa, Rām. 1, 24, 3.
लक्ष्मी- + पुत्र लक्ष्मी- + पुत्र, m. 1. Kāma. 2. a horse.
लक्ष्मी- + पुष्प लक्ष्मी- + पुष्प, m. a ruby.
लक् लक्, see रक्.

लक्तक लक्तक, n.
 1. A rag, or rags.
 2. i. e. = रक्त + क (vb. रञ्ज्), Lac, the animal dye.

लक्ष् लक्ष् i. 10 (probably a denomin. derived from लक्ष), Par. and Ātm.
 1. To mark, MBh. 3, 14852.
 2. To see, Vikr. d. 8; to perceive, Śāk. 16, 20. Pass. To appear, Vikr. d. 53; MBh. 3, 2110.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. लक्षित, Perceived, evident, Bhāg. P. 4, 25, 13.
 --Comp.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass. लक्ष्य.
 1. To be seen, visible, Vikr. d. 37; Daśak. in Chr. 198, 24.
 2. Deserving to be regarded, Hit. iv. d. 14.
 3. To be defined or described, Vedāntas. in Chr. 210, 10.
 4. Having attributes attached, Vedāntas. in Chr. 212, 14; 23. n.
 1. A mark.
 2. A butt.
 3. Aim, Utt. Rāmac. 124, 8 (बद्ध, vb. बन्ध्, adj. Having taken his aim); Megh. 72 (कामिन्-, Aim, represented by lovers).
 4. Object, Vedāntas. in Chr. 205, 22.
 5. A Lac, a hundred thousand, Hit. ii. d. 36.
 --Comp.
 अ-, adj. 1. invisible, Kathās. 24, 8. 2. undistinguishable, unimportant, Kumāras. 5, 72.
 अभि-लक्ष्य + म्, [] adv. to the aim, Rām. 2, 63, 22.
 दुर्ल्˚, i. e. दुस्-, adj. difficult to be perceived, Bhāg. P. 7, 10, 53.
 यूप-, m. a bird.
 स्थूल-, adj. 1. = स्थूल-लक्ष (see लक्ष). 2. aiming carelessly.
 --Caus.
 1. To cause to be seen, to perform, to settle, Chr. 20, 17.
 2. To signify, Vedāntas. in Chr. 204, 17.
 --With the prep. अभि अभि, अभिलक्षित, Marked.
 --With आ आ,
 1. To see, to perceive, MBh. 2, 2403.
 2. To view, Daśak. in Chr. 186, 12. Pass. To appear, Śāk. d. 133. आलक्ष्य, Śāk. d. 176, is लक्ष्य with आ, adj. Hardly visible.
 --With समा सम्-आ,
 1. To direct one's look to, Lass. 2. ed. 66, 17.
 2. To see, MBh. 1, 5249.
 --With उप उप,
 1. To see, to perceive, Vikr. 78, 21; MBh. 3, 2186.
 2. To suspect, Śāk. 15, 15.
 3. To consider, MBh. 3, 12188.
 4. Pass. To be probable, Rām. 2, 61, 11. उपलक्षित, Comprehended, understood.
 --Comp.
 अन्-, adj. not perceived, Daśak. in Chr. 190, 15.
 --With समुप सम्-उप. To see, to perceive, MBh. 2, 1557.
 --With निस् निस्; निर्लक्ष्य, Kathās. 6, 119, is लक्ष्य with निस्, adj. Imperceivable.
 --With वि वि, To perceive, Gīt. 2, 19; to see, Pañc. 235, 25. विलक्षित,
 1. Seen.
 2. Affected without a cause.
 3. Disappointed, Utt. Rāmac. 148, 13; Johns. Sel. 52, 115 (rival).
 4. Unmarked (i. e. लक्षित with वि, adj.).
 --With सम् सम्,
 1. To perceive, MBh. 3, 16751.
 2. Pass. To appear, Vikr. d. 157. संलक्षित, Distinguished. संलक्ष्य, To be marked.
 --Comp.
 दुःस्˚, i. e. दुस्-, adj. difficult to be perceived, Rājat. 6, 64.

लक्ष लक्ष, probably from रङ्ज्, and for original रक्त,
 I. n.
 1. A mark, MBh. 3, 14852; Caurap. 15.
 2. Aim, Ragh. 1, 61; Vikr. 54, 4 (? look, perhaps corr. ˚लक्षणः). []
 3. Disguise, fraud.
 II. m., and f. क्षा, and n. (Pañc. 255, 23), A Lac, a hundred thousand, Pañc. 255, 23.
 --Comp.

लाक्षा लाक्षा, i. e. लक्ष = लक्त in लक्तक (q. cf.), + अ, f. Lac, the animal dye, Ṛt. 6, 13.
 --Comp.

लक्षण लक्षण, i. e. लक्ष् + अन,
 I. n.
 1. Seeing, sight.
 2. A characteristic mark, Pañc. iii. d. 130; Bhartṛ. 2, 70; a spot.
 3. A holy mark, Hit. 99, 7; a lucky mark, Daśak. in Chr. 197, 11.
 4. Form, Bhāg. P. 5, 20, 38.
 5. A name, Pañc. iii. d. 35 (read यात्रालक्षणम्, called यात्रा).
 6. An indication, a definition, Man. 1, 112.
 7. Settlement, 8, 406.
 8. A symptom of actual disease.
 II. m.
 1. The Indian crane.
 2. A proper name.
 III. f. ना.
 1. Metonymy, as distinguished from a word's literal meaning, Vedāntas. in Chr. 212, 16; Bhāṣāp. 81. Cf. Sāhitya Darp. 11.
 2. The female of the Indian crane.
 3. A goose.
 --Comp.
लक्षित- + लक्षण लक्षित- + लक्षण, adj., f. णा, in which are evident the marks (of a town), Bhāg. P. 4, 25, 13.
लक्षता लक्ष + ता, f. Condition of being the aim, Daśak. in Chr. 184, 24.
लक्षितत्व लक्षित + त्व (vb. लक्ष्), n. Condition of being hinted at, of being supplied, Vedāntas. in Chr. 214, 15.

लक्ष्मण लक्ष्मण, i. e. लक्ष्मन् + अ,
 I. m.
 1. The son of Daśaratha by Sumitrā, Rām. 3, 50, 24.
 2. The Indian crane, Arj. 9, 21.
 II. f. णा, The female of the Indian crane.
 III. n.
 1. A mark, a spot, Śiś. 9, 31 (and at the same time Lakṣmaṇa).
 --Comp.

लक्ष्मन् लक्ष् + मन्, n.
 1. A mark, Ragh. 19, 30; a spot, Śāk. d. 19.
 2. Chief.

लक्ष्मी लक्ष्मी, i. e. लक्ष्म (i. e. curtailed लक्ष्मन्), + ई, f. (nom. sing. मीस्).
 1. The wife of Viṣṇu, and goddess of prosperity, Rām. 3, 52, 26; Hit. pr. d. 31, M.M.
 2. Prosperity, Bhartṛ. 2, 54.
 3. Wealth, Bhartṛ. 2, 14; Rājat. 5, 18.
 4. Beauty, splendour, Kir. 5, 39; Vikr. d. 23; Śāk. d. 19.
 5. Royal power, Pañc. iii. d. 32; dominion, Rājat. 5, 136.
 6. Superhuman power.
 7. Sīta, the wife of Rāma.
 8. A pearl.
 --Comp.
ऽलक्ष्मीक -लक्ष्मी + क, at the end of comp. adj.; e. g. पुत्र-सम्-क्रान्त-, Having transferred the royal power to (their) sons, Utt. Rāmac. 14, 15.

लक्ष्मीवन्त् लक्ष्मी + वन्त्, adj., f. वती,
 1. Fortunate.
 2. Wealthy.
लक्ष्यता लक्ष्य + ता (see लक्ष्), f. Visibility, Rājat. 5, 321.
लाक्षणिक लाक्षणिक, i. e. लक्षण + इक, adj., f. की, Characteristic.

लाक्षिक लाक्षिक, adj.
 1. i. e. लाक्षा + इक, Made of lac, dyed with lac, Pāṇ. iv. 2, 2.
 2. i. e. लक्ष + इक, Relating to a large number or a Lac.
